items.title: Keeper fold: unknown event type surfaces as integrity problem, not silent skip
items.description: server-L1-routing judge note on PG-ROUTER-REOPEN (PR #39, 2026-10-16): fold() has no else branch, so older code silently skips new event types (item_reopened now, state_set at 1b923e5). verify_chain stays green but verify_integrity reports cache_mismatch for affected keys, and a rebuild with old code undoes the event. Routing asks for this ahead of the batched 5-verb live-sync if cheap.
items.done_criteria: fold() has an explicit unknown-type branch; verify_integrity reports 'unknown_event_type' (type, seq) for any event type the running code does not know, instead of skipping it silently; fold/verify agree; tests incl. a chain with a synthetic unknown type; 2 non-Claude seats; merged
